Qaphela:

 1. Nxa amaCoin engabonakali emva kokuthenga, thinta ubuyisela ukuze uzame futhi
 2. Ngaphandle kwamaCoin atholakala ngezindlela ezitshiyeneyo kule application, amaCoin athengiweyo ehlisa isidingo sokwenza imisebenzi etshiyeneyo ngaphakathi, njalo acitsha izimemezelo
 3. AmaCoin yizinto ezingabonakaliyo, kasibuyiseli imali.
 4. AmaCoin abotshelwe kule application efakiweyo, ukwesula idatha ye-application kususa lokhu kuxhumana (kungatshintsha).
